card: RX 7900 XTX (fabric j3211 + j3213 hipx, confounded=false)
summary: Node bench (standalone hipcc harness built for gfx1100, bit-identical to gemm_bf16_xf32_batched/_xbf16_batched at every row count 1..4096, odd M/K/N included; guard run j3210 OK). Router shape (M128 K2560, F32 x). 1 row/CTA vs 4 rows/CTA, us per call: p1 wins up to N=22 (p1 8.5 vs p4 8.8), p4 from N=24 (p4 8.9 vs p1 17.5); 24 is the first measured row count where p4 wins. Previous route (gemm_bf16_xf32_batched, the only BF16 route on gfx1100) measured 13-3548 us (router) / 32-1453 us (selector) over the swept row counts; the small-rows kernels are 2.8x-18x faster at every measured row count.
